title: neolaugeria resinosa
intro: Neolaugeria resinosa, commonly known as Red Mountain tea or Red Mountain rosemary, is a flowering plant species in the family Ledocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Neolaugeria resinosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
